6E.8 Land ownership can pass by inheritance.

points: This is the land of Canaan that falls to Israel for inheritance, with the coasts thereof; the south quarter runs from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, the south border from the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward, fetching a compass unto the river of Egypt and out at the sea.

note.label: Numbers 34: The Borders of the Land of Canaan

points: This is going into how far the land stretched. When reading these borders, look at the map and visualize how the land is stretched, border by border.

note.label: Numbers 34: The Borders of the Land of Canaan

points: The western border is the great sea; the north border runs from the great sea to mount Hor and the entrance of Hamath out to Hazar-enan; the east border goes down from Shepham to Riblah, reaches unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward, and goes down Jordan out at the salt sea.

note.label: Numbers 34: The Borders of the Land of Canaan

points: Moses commanded that this is the land to be inherited by lot, which the Lord commanded to give unto the nine tribes and to the half tribe; for Reuben, Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, had already received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward.
Levi did not get an inheritance of land, because Levi was scattered throughout all the other tribes' lands to do the service of the Lord.

note.label: Numbers 34: The Borders of the Land of Canaan

points: The Lord named the men which shall divide the land: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun, and one prince of every tribe, Caleb the son of Jephunneh for Judah and the rest by name.

note.label: Numbers 34: The Borders of the Land of Canaan

points: These are they whom the Lord commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan: the princes of all the twelve tribes that divided the land to all the tribes.
